newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-ATLETICO MADRID BREEZE TO 4-1 WIN AT WIDZEW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO MADRID BREEZE TO 4-1 WIN AT WIDZEW.

text.p: Atletico Madrid crushed Widzew Lodz 4-1 on Wednesday with a superior display which gave them their second big win in the European Cup Champions' League.

Diego Simeone scored twice as Atletico, who swamped Steaua Bucharest 4-0 in their opening game in Group B, penetrated the Widzew defence almost at will, allowing few counter-attacks by the Polish champions.

Atletico went 2-0 up through Yugoslav Milinko Pantic in the 24th minute and midfielder Simeone in the 32nd before Widzew's Marek Citko lobbed the ball over the head of goalkeeper Jose Molina in the last minute of the first half.
Simeone scored again in the 60th minute and striker Kiko Narvaez added the fourth a minute later to seal victory for the Spanish champions.
Widzew are without a point in Group B, having been beaten 2-1 by Germany's Borussia Dortmund in their opening Champions' League game.
Atletico's quick-passing attack often pierced the Widzew defence, while the home team's counter-attacks foundered a dozen times against the Spanish side's offside trap.
"Atletico took advanatage of all their chances...They are a very good team and they dictated the pace of the game to the end," Widzew coach Francziszek Smuda said.

Referee Anders Frisk booked Widzew's Andzej Michalczuk, who also received a yellow card against Dortmund and will miss the next game, and Zbigniew Wyciczkiewicz. The Swedish referee also booked Atletico scorers Pantic and Simeone.
